description: Golden Q/A set for the Flipkart product recommender RAG eval (Decision 19). Questions reflect the review corpus; ground_truth + ground_truth_contexts are used by RAGAS for faithfulness, answer_relevancy, context_precision, context_recall.

items.question: How is the battery backup on the BoAt Rockerz 235v2 headphones?
items.ground_truth: Reviewers report roughly 6 to 8 hours of battery backup, with fast charging giving about 4 hours from a 20-minute charge.
ground_truth_contexts: battery back up to 6 to 8 hours, fast charging: 20 min charge gives up to 4 hours backup

items.question: Are the BoAt Rockerz 235v2 good for gaming?
items.ground_truth: No. Reviewers note the product does not support gaming well and recommend it for music rather than gaming.
ground_truth_contexts: for gaming that product does not support 100%, recommended for music not gaming

items.question: How is the sound quality and bass?
items.ground_truth: Reviewers describe high bass and good sound clarity, with super sound overall.
ground_truth_contexts: bass is very high, sound clarity is good, super sound

items.question: Is the build flexible and good looking?
items.ground_truth: Yes, reviewers mention it is flexible and has an attractive, good-looking design.
ground_truth_contexts: more flexible, killing look awesome, good looking

items.question: Is this product worth the price?
items.ground_truth: Reviewers consider it good value, saying no other wireless headphones compare at this price.
ground_truth_contexts: no more wireless headphones are comparing with that headphones at this price

items.question: How fast does it charge?
items.ground_truth: It supports fast charging: about 20 minutes of charge provides up to 4 hours of playback.
ground_truth_contexts: fastest charging system, only 20 min charge and get long up to 4 hours back up

items.question: Does it connect over Bluetooth?
items.ground_truth: Yes, it is a Bluetooth headset (Bluetooth 5.0 / wireless).

items.question: Would you recommend it for music listening?
items.ground_truth: Yes, reviewers strongly recommend it for music, citing good sound and value.
ground_truth_contexts: this product is very well for you for only music, super sound and good looking
